primary_correction: Holm over the five B0 contrasts
secondary_correction: Holm over all thirty benchmark-by-control contrasts, also reported
interval: 5000 crossed bootstrap draws over training seeds and shared test initial states; marginal 95% intervals
test: two-sided exact sign flips of training-seed mean paired differences; conditional on fixed test cases and symmetry assumption
limitation: With ten seeds, no two-sided exact contrast can pass the global Holm-30 family at 0.05; secondary contrasts are descriptive unless more independent training is preregistered. Primary B0 family is not a global guarantee across benchmarks.
selection: Final checkpoint for every training; no selection by final evaluation; all failures retained
reason: Separate the original nominal-task hypotheses from zero-retraining stress tests before any final test evaluation, while retaining the stricter global correction transparently.
